channel.description: Pre-release Flipped updates. Pete tests on his Mac before promoting to the public appcast.xml. Run `scripts/promote-release.sh` from the flipped-web-work repo to move a release from beta to stable.

item.description: Fixes the removal process. Removing Flipped now returns your iPhone straight to the Home Screen without prompting to restore or transfer anything, and without losing app data.
